subject.title: refactor: flip sessions and transcripts to sqlite storage

question: Should this SQLite migration also change existing users to keep reset/deleted transcript archives indefinitely with a default 2 GiB cleanup budget?
rationale: That choice changes deletion, privacy, disk-usage, and downgrade expectations; correctness review can require safe mechanics but cannot choose the intended product policy.

options.title: Preserve current defaults
options.body: Land the SQLite migration without changing retention or disk-budget defaults, then review the cold-tier policy separately.

options.title: Approve corrected cold-tier defaults
options.body: Ship keep-by-default archives only after one unified archive-plus-database budget proves archive-first eviction and upgrade behavior.

recommendation.title: Preserve current defaults
recommendation.body: Land the SQLite migration without changing retention or disk-budget defaults, then review the cold-tier policy separately.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the retention redesign and explicitly identified these shipped default changes as needing design sign-off.
